Axiom: Canonical layout: `src/routes/` for routes, `src/lib/` for shared client+server code, `src/lib/server/` for server-only code, `src/hooks.server.ts` / `src/hooks.client.ts` for hooks, `src/app.html` for the HTML shell, `src/app.d.ts` for ambient types, `static/` for unprocessed assets. The `$lib` alias points to `src/lib`; `$lib/server` is automatically server-only.
